about: memory.mts --budgets: what the game holds at the playable title on SwiftShader (the CI no-GPU boot smoke job runs it after boot). A number over its budget fails; a number more than underPct under fails until the budget is lowered (the failure names the new value, measured plus headroomPct), so budgets only go down. Set 2026-11-05 from main 4a59c38: three runs on 8 vCPUs gave WebGL 1542.9-1560.2 MB and 244-247 textures. Lowered when the first-visit boot started building at the classified GPU tier (SwiftShader classifies as low): WebGL 1418.1 MB, textures 1261.1 MB in 246. Lowered when Assets.texture() images and the kong maps started dropping their decoded copies after upload: texture CPU copies 268.6 MB.
